$schema-note: Image provenance manifest for images DERIVED from retained schematic PDFs by local rasterisation. Kept separate from media/manifest.json so that no pre-existing file is modified; an index owner may merge them.
global_notes: These are NOT photographs and NOT vendor-published images. Each is a crop of a page the vendor published as a vector PDF, rasterised locally at 300 dpi.

pdfimages could not be used: pdfimages -list reports ZERO embedded rasters in every source PDF here. The drawings are vector, so pdftoppm plus a crop is the only route. This is recorded because reaching for pdfimages is the obvious wrong first move.

Copyright in the underlying drawing remains with the vendor named in creator_rightsholder. Licence is UNKNOWN: no licence statement appears in any of the source PDFs. Redistribution status unknown; disposition repository, unstaged pending user review.
Every image is reproducible byte-for-byte from the retained artifact using the recorded generation_command, so none of them is uniquely held here.
Each image exists because it settles a specific documented question; see why_retained.

images.caption: Schematic crop: charger U6, part string TP4065, drawn with FIVE pins
images.alt_text: Schematic detail showing a five-pin IC symbol labelled U6 / TP4065. Pin 4 VCC at top, pin 1 CHRG at left driving LED1 through R9 2K, pin 3 BAT at right, pin 5 PROG with R13 2K, pin 2 GND at bottom. A dashed note box to the right carries the rotated text 'IBAT (mA) = 580'.
images.why_retained: Settles the charger package conflict: the schematic symbol has five pins, not SOP-8, matching the owner-reported 5-lead TSOT-23. Also shows the vendor's own 580 mA charge-current annotation.

images.caption: Schematic crop: the two 12-way headers P1 and P2 with their net labels
images.alt_text: Schematic detail showing two twelve-pin header symbols side by side, each captioned 'Header 12'. P2's pins 11 to 5 carry net labels GPIO1, GPIO2, GPIO3, GPIO10, GPIO11, GPIO12, GPIO13; P1's pins 11 to 6 carry U0TXD, U0RXD, IIC_SDA, IIC_SCL, ESP_TP_RESET, ESP_TP_INT. Pins 4 and 3 of P2 and pin 4 of P1 carry X no-connect markers.
images.why_retained: Fixes the label-to-pin binding for the header pinout, which the text layer alone leaves ambiguous at plus or minus 1.7 points: pin 12 of P2 runs unbroken to a VDD3V3 power port, which proves labels sit above their wire.
